cost_crossings.definition: No fitted small-profit threshold: only crossings of saved cost boundaries.

entry_below_frozen_long_stop.handling: Original rows and stop-touch economics preserved. This geometry can book a positive SL; no gap repricing, repair or exclusion performed.

hash_verification_scope: Pinned byte/content integrity, not a digital signer, certified market data or independent proof of real fills.

inherited_parent_scope_not_closed_long_s.scope: Copied parent 301 closed + 1 open + 1889 rejected; not 256 long-only admission outcomes. No PnL assigned to open/rejected rows.

liquid123_separate_identity_only.economic_units: Saved gross/net/realized_cost_bps are scaled; instrument_* fields are separate unscaled values.

source_feature_gate.all_winner_recovery_status: UNKNOWN; final win and TIMEOUT do not prove recovery or safe early exit
source_feature_gate.exit_clock: Native evaluator stores exit bar open ts. SL uses that bar low/high; TIMEOUT uses that bar close. Neither gives actual intrabar availability.
missing: feature values and available_ts at the original signal
signal close and feature provenance needed for entry-chase
intrabar fill/stop/partial lifecycle and outcome available_ts
full child admission/rejection chronology after changed exits or entries
source_feature_gate.native_execution_model_caveat: Saved delayed evaluator fills at sealed stop on touch and at timeout close; it records no separate gap/partial/stop-update events. Do not upgrade this to a real-fill guarantee.

units.cost_2x: posthoc gross - 2*realized_cost_bps, not execution input, cost3, or a fresh run
units.decimal_encoding: JSON strings, Decimal(saved numeric spelling), precision 80; native float rounding residual reported.
units.drawdown: Sum-of-trade-bps accounting curves, no mark-to-market, intrabar drawdown, capital or NAV claim.
units.economic_values: Unweighted sum of saved per-trade bps; no quantity, money or NAV mapping.
